title: deriveProfileFields: relax the now-over-conservative comma/brace reject guard + fix its stale comment (TASK-162 follow-up)
description:
Follow-up minted from the TASK-162 gating review (rev-162, APPROVE, 2026-07-14, LOW finding). TASK-162 made src/project-md.js inline-object frontmatter (agent_models/perfil_proyecto maps) escape-aware on BOTH write (renderProjectMd -> encodeMapEntry) and read (coerceFrontmatterScalar -> splitInlineMapPairs + decodeMapEntry), so a map value containing a literal comma or brace now round-trips losslessly.

src/design-profile.js#deriveProfileFields (~lines 311-318) still carries a PRE-EMPTIVE reject guard that throws loudly if an emitted perfil_proyecto value would contain a comma or brace. Post-TASK-162 that guard is (a) over-conservative — it rejects values the encoder would now handle fine — and (b) its inline comment is FACTUALLY STALE: it claims "project-md.js splits on unescaped ',' and strips '{'/'}'", but splitInlineMapPairs is now escape-aware. The guard never fires on today's controlled enum/number/boolean profile sources, so this is not a live bug — correctness-of-documentation + future-proofing only.

FIX DIRECTION (pick one): (1) RELAX — remove/loosen the guard now that the encoder tolerates commas/braces, letting deriveProfileFields emit free-form values that round-trip; OR (2) MINIMAL — keep the guard but correct the now-inaccurate comment to state that the guard is a belt-and-suspenders constraint on profile values, NOT a workaround for a naive parser (which no longer exists). Prefer (1) only if there is a real near-term need for comma-bearing profile values; otherwise (2) is the lighter, honest fix. Whichever is chosen, keep tests/design-profile.spec.js's 'throws_loudly_if_an_emitted_value_would_contain_a_comma_or_brace' spec consistent with the decision (update it if the guard is relaxed).

verification_tier tests-after if it's a guard-relax with a round-trip regression lock; uat-only acceptable if it is a pure comment correction with no behavior change.
acceptance_criteria: A decision is recorded (relax vs comment-only) with rationale; if relaxed, deriveProfileFields emits a comma/brace-bearing perfil_proyecto value that round-trips losslessly through the real writeProjectMd -> readProjectMd (regression lock), and the design-profile.spec.js reject spec is updated to match.

If comment-only: the stale inline comment in deriveProfileFields no longer claims project-md.js splits on unescaped commas / strips braces (it is now escape-aware), and the guard's true purpose is stated honestly; the existing reject spec still passes unchanged.
src/design-profile.js does not bundle into dist (verify) — if it does, dist rebuilt + committed, dist-parity green.
Full fast tier + the design-profile-* e2e specs stay green.
